decision: Executable-policy synthetic training and action-gold benchmark, plus independent-source StepGuard action transfer evaluation.

candidates.name: AgentDrift
candidates.disposition: Not used as safety gold for this experiment.
observations: Primary documentation discloses severe world-identity/category leakage in four domains.
Injection-point and failed-injection labels depend on observations and subsequent behavior, not on current pre-action violation.
Hijacked includes task deviation that is not necessarily harmful or permission-violating; examined development examples include a syntax check and bookmarking.
An examined injection-point observation only contained a suspicious link, without the claimed injected instruction. No claim of a full independent dataset audit is made.

candidates.name: StepGuard-Data
candidates.disposition: External action-level evaluation only, not training.
observations: The released training corpus explicitly distinguishes action-level guarding from retrospective trajectory auditing; only action examples are retained.
3500 action examples before input deduplication, 3178 after identical-input deduplication; conflicting duplicate labels would stop preparation.
Exact history-continuation/action-occurrence audit found no usable unsafe chronological pairs; these cannot be invented from isolated actions.
Reference rationale, risk-source metadata and requested generative answer format are not passed to Kev. Input fields and binary gold are separated.
Labels are synthetic/model-assisted, and their universality is not certified by us. Broader safety scope differs from the synthetic explicit-policy task.

candidates.name: Existing ATBench and TS-Bench runs
candidates.disposition: Not used as the new confirmatory test or as reused trained initialization.
observations: ATBench trajectory labels do not supply pre-action gold, and earlier aggregation was sensitive to final refusals.
TS-Bench binary labels alone do not establish a monotonic severity order; previously trained adapters are not warm starts for new arms.

synthetic_scope: Narrow formal permission/taint/budget compliance with independently checked construction and visible-prefix interpreter labels. Not a substitute for natural-domain transfer evidence.
synthetic_uncertainty_scope: Bootstrap estimates conditional variation over counterfactual worlds generated from these fixed recipe families. They are not confidence intervals over all real-world task families.
